summary: Tested taller_equipos tracking and repair delivery features. All 12 backend tests pass. Fixed a frontend bug where clicking 'Marcar como Entregada' on repair quotes didn't open the RepairDeliveryDialog.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED: confirmEmailAndProceed() was missing 'deliver' action handler, causing RepairDeliveryDialog to not open after email customization

seed_data_creation: Test data created during backend tests with prefix 'TEST_' and 'SN-' for serials
context_for_next_testing_agent: The taller_equipos tracking feature is fully functional. When a repair quote is approved, serials are inserted into taller_equipos with status 'En reparación'. The repair-delivery-prep endpoint returns equipment grouped by model. The repair-deliver endpoint updates status to 'Entregado' and generates a PDF Nota de Entrega. The RepairDeliveryDialog component works correctly after the fix to confirmEmailAndProceed().

backend: POST /api/quotes/{quote_id}/approve for repair quotes creates records in taller_equipos with estatus 'En reparación'
GET /api/quotes/{quote_id}/repair-delivery-prep returns equipment grouped by model with serials
POST /api/quotes/{quote_id}/repair-deliver updates taller_equipos to 'Entregado', changes quote status to 'Entregada', generates PDF
GET /api/taller-equipos returns equipment list with filtering by client_id and estatus
frontend: RepairDeliveryDialog renders with equipment selection checkboxes, delivery method options, and submit button
Clicking 'Marcar como Entregada' on a repair quote opens RepairDeliveryDialog (after email customization)
